Subject: Proposed: Consolidated ML coding + systems screen for Elliot Zhang (75m)

Hi all —

We have Elliot Zhang (ex-Scale AI, strong MLOps background) on the calendar for a technical screen next week. Talent asked if we can consolidate the usual two-stage flow (30m model/code + 30m systems/design) into a single 75m session to reduce scheduling churn — candidate prefers fewer handoffs.

Proposal: one 75-minute session that covers:
- 35m hands-on coding + model debugging (CoderPad)
- 25m system design / productionization discussion (short prompt, architecture tradeoffs)
- 10m debrief + candidate Q&A / next steps

Why: Elliot's background suggests the two areas are tightly coupled for this role; consolidating should give interviewers a fuller picture and shorten calendar back-and-forth.

Logistics I can set up if we agree: CoderPad session (session ready), ephemeral GCP notebook for quick profiling if needed, and the usual debrief rubric pre-populated. Links below and attachments include resume + runbook.

Proposed times (candidate availability from talentseed):
- Tue Apr 3, 10:30–11:45 PT
- Wed Apr 4, 08:00–09:15 PT

Please reply with: A) availability for either slot, B) any strong objections to consolidation, and C) if you'd like to split scoring (separate coding vs systems columns) or use a combined score.

Attachments: Elliot_Zhang_resume.pdf, ml-coding-runbook-v2.md
Links: CoderPad: https://coderpad.io/session/RC-7721 | Runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_runbook

Thanks —
Priya
